Related trust-layer plugins: Verificati"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"on Receipt, Evidence Audit, and Context Provenance."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`dsh-telemetry-redactor` is a minimal DeepSeek Harness Profile Bundle that redacts sensitive values "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"from session telemetry before a backend receives them. It mounts on the official `session-telemetry/"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"record` waterfall, calls `next()` so other deployment rules still compose, and returns a new recursi"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"vely redacted record."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The official telemetry coordinator deep-copies canonical session events before this waterfall and co"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ntains thrown rules per record. Therefore this plugin changes only the outbound copy: it never rewri"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tes the canonical session log. In this document, **fail-closed means only that this coordinator with"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"holds one failing export copy** and continues the agent loop. It is not a claim that every telemetry"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" path or listener order is impossible to bypass."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it redacts"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Values under high-risk key names such as `authorization`, `cookie`, `credential`, `password`, `sec"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ret`, `token`, `apiKey`, `access_token`, `clientSecret`, and `privateKey`; recognized credential pat"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"terns in key names are replaced too.
- Bearer and Basic authorization values embedded in strings.
- "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"Common credential forms including `sk-...`, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, JWT-like triples, and `toke"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"n=...` / `api_key: ...` assignments."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Keys are tokenized before matching, so telemetry counters such as `inputTokens`, `output_tokens`, `t"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"okenUsage`, `tokenCount`, and `contextTokenCount`, and ordinary fields such as `tokenizer`, remain i"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ntact. Redaction is a safety filter, not a proof that an arbitrary unknown secret format is absent. "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"The exact supported and unsupported cases are in SECRET-MATRIX.md; see SECURITY.md for the trust bou"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"act supported and unsupported cases are in SECRET-MATRIX.md; see SECURITY.md for the trust boundary."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The listener is prepended so it normally wraps deployment rules mounted before or after it and redac"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ts their final output. A deliberately prepended outer listener can still add content after this plug"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"in; review the complete waterfall listener set in security-sensitive deployments."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install the public package into the selected DSH profile, then inspect the resolved configuration:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The dump must contain the inserted `telemetry-redactor` row. The bundle does not add, replace, or en"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"able a telemetry backend; it only protects records handled by whatever backend the deployment alread"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"metry backend; it only protects records handled by whatever backend the deployment already selected."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The only option is `replacement`, which defaults to `[REDACTED]`. It must contain 1 to 128 character"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"s and must not itself match a supported credential pattern; invalid values fail loudly when the Cord"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"is plugin fiber is awaited."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The key and pattern rules are fixed security behavior and cannot be disabled through configuration."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Verification"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The tests include a real Cordis Loader composition with the `SessionTelemetryCoordinator`: the backe"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"nd receives the replacement while the authoritative session event retains the fixture secret, and an"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" over-deep record is withheld without escaping the capture handler. Release smokes use the packaged "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"frozen fixture for official commit `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`: it pins the reviewed "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"source hashes, exact published runtime versions and runtime-file hashes, then verifies the required "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"Cordis/session/LLM/coordinator API surface before composing it with the built or tarball-installed p"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"lugin. `test:official-patch` similarly pins the reviewed Include source hash before applying `cordis"},{"id":"p23s8","text":".patch.yml`. No environment variable or installed official checkout is required."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"None. The plugin observes an outbound telemetry copy after session logging and contributes no prompt"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" text, tool schema, message, or provider request."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"#### KV Cache effect"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"None; no model request changes."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Unknown secret formats that have neither a sensitive key nor a recognized string pattern may pass "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"through. Add deterministic coverage before extending the fixed patterns.
- Accessor properties and n"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"on-plain objects are rejected rather than read or silently converted. Enumerable JSON data in arrays"},{"id":"p29s4","text":", ordinary objects, and null-prototype objects is supported; non-enumerable fields are outside the t"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"elemetry contract.
- A key-name match redacts the complete value. This favors safety over retaining "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"structure beneath fields named as credentials.
- Redaction occurs synchronously on the telemetry cap"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ture path. The implementation is recursive and bounded to 64 nested containers; very large but shall"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ow records still cost linear CPU time.
- A Proxy can run or throw from reflection traps before the p"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"lugin can inspect its contents. The official coordinator's own `structuredClone` normally rejects a "},{"id":"p29s10","text":"Proxy before this waterfall; direct third-party dispatch is not a supported hostile-object sandbox.
"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"- `dsh.plugin.json` is supplemental community metadata. DSH installation is controlled by `package.j"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"son`'s `dsh.bundle` field and `cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
